<thought>From the 13C NMR data, the signals in the aromatic region (≈120‑150 ppm) are at 139.25, 134.60, 129.00 (appearing twice), and 128.30 (appearing twice). Counting each carbon represented by these signals gives 1 + 1 + 2 + 2 = 6 aromatic carbons.</thought>
<final_answer>6</final_answer>
